title: Ring Flight with Boost, Horizon Lock, and Quick Brake to Hover
description:
Purpose: Smooth ring-powered flight with optional boost, bank limits, horizon lock, and quick brake to enter hover.

Behaviour:
- Entry: From ground or hover, A (Right) double-tap enters flight. If in hover and speed ~0, treat as ascend into flight with gentle lift.
- Controls:
  - Left Thumbstick: translates forward/strafe in the active orientation mode (head or controller relative).
  - Right Thumbstick: if settings map to altitude, Right Stick Y maps to climb/descent; otherwise it contributes to yaw/pitch assist. Both supported via params:
    - params.value("right_stick_altitude_mode", true)
    - params.value("altitude_rate_mps", 2.0)
  - Left Thumbstick Click: hold to engage boost. Boost uses accel curve and clamps at params.value("boost_max_speed_mps", 12.0) with base flight speed params.value("base_speed_mps", 5.0).
  - B (Right) tap: Quick brake — lerp velocity to 0 in 0.25s, then call into hover_mode_mechanic to engage hover state at current position.
- Bank/horizon:
  - Bank is clamped to params.value("bank_max_deg", 20.0) and eased. If CLocomotionSettings.horizon_lock is true, gradually remove roll to keep horizon level, favoring comfort.
- Energy:
  - Drains CRingEnergy at base rate params.value("drain_per_s", 1.0) and additional drain during boost params.value("boost_extra_drain_per_s", 3.0). When ring_energy is low, limit to base speed and disable boost. Emergency hover still allowed on brake.
- VFX:
  - Publish speed scalar for flight_trail_fx and FOV easing value (0..1) for camera system. Keep subtle to respect comfort.

Quest 3 bindings (params_json):
- params.value("entry_button", "A_right")
- params.value("boost_button", "L_stick_click")
- params.value("brake_button", "B_right")

Components read/write:
- Reads CMechanicBinding, CTransform, CPhysics, CRingEnergy, CLocomotionSettings.
- Writes CFlightState{ active:bool, boost:bool }, CPhysics velocity and orientation targets; emits events: "flight.start", "flight.stop", "flight.boost_on", "flight.boost_off", consumed by haptics_audio_feedback.

Comfort/safety:
- Speed-scaled vignette when enabled; bank limit and optional horizon lock; soft pushback near scene bounds.
- Disable in CTag{"no_fly"} zones; auto-swap back to hover/ground.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_flight_basics: Double-tap A to fly; boost on Left Stick Click; adjust altitude via Right Thumbstick if enabled; B to quick stop into hover.
- test_orbital_dogfight: Supports open space flight in orbital_battlefield.

Integration points:
- On B brake completion, call hover_mode_mechanic public API to engage hover.
- Works alongside promoted.ring_charge_and_recharge CRingEnergy component.

Assets/scenes: training_arena, orbital_battlefield, oa_defense, alien_city, asteroid_outpost.
